cell_1: Model developments improved fitting, with minor implications for stock status and projected ABC/OFL.
cell_2: Egg and larval abundance was low; later prey conditions were favorable. Cannibalism was a small share of observed adult pollock diets.

cell_4: A-season fishing appeared good; later B-season fishing was farther north than normal, with limited desirable sizes.
